subject: BrightGrid renewal & expansion play + action plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightgrid.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGrid renewal & expansion play + action plan

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Key takeaways
- Current usage: ~3.2M tokens/month with predictable weekly spikes tied to batch ingestion jobs. (see attached usage CSV)
- Primary pain: p95 latency spikes during morning batch windows and unpredictable token spikes impacting costs.
- New workloads: expanding RAG + embeddings for internal search and a short-form summarization job for support tickets.
- Success criteria for expansion: p95 generation latency <150ms for sub-256 token requests, and a unit cost reduction of at least 22% vs current hosted spend.

Proposed pilot (timeline & scope)
- 60-day Dedicated pilot on a 2x A100 pool (dedicated capacity) to validate latency and cost targets.
- Redwood will enable prefix caching and optimized batching + a quantized model profile for the summarization workload.
- Deliverables: proposal PDF, pilot SOW, weekly telemetry dashboard, and a final recommendations doc.

Estimated economics (ballpark)
- Pilot monthly commit: ~$18,500 (includes reserved capacity + monitoring) — detailed pricing in attached proposal.

Next steps (action owners)
1) Stephanie: send proposal + success criteria checklist (attached) — done.
2) Alex: confirm technical stakeholders for a scoping call (can we do 2 May?)
3) Jordan / Margo: procurement timeline and PO cadence; Jack will need invoice + tax ID.
4) Dev / Monica: schedule technical scoping (once Alex confirms).

Please reply with any corrections. If that works, I’ll send a short SOW and DocuSign for the pilot and block time for the technical scoping call.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-7172

Attachment stubs:
- brightgrid-monthly-usage-apr2027.csv (CSV)
- redwood-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf (PDF)
- pilot-success-criteria-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightgrid.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@brightgrid.com>, Margo Lee <margo.lee@brightgrid.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:01:30 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid renewal & expansion play + action plan

Stephanie —

Thanks for the sharp summary, appreciate it. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The token spikes are primarily from a daily backfill job that runs between 02:00–03:30 PT; it ramps up calls to the hosted model and we see p95 latency go from ~120ms to ~480ms during that window.
- Security/compliance is acceptable for a Dedicated pilot as long as audit logs are retained for 90 days and we have access to per-request tracing.
- New workloads: embeddings for search (approx. 50M vectors/year projected) and an on-demand summarization endpoint for support agents (higher QPS during business hours).

Procurement: Margo will handle PO but timeline is tight — target to approve pilot in ~6 weeks. We can commit to a 60-day pilot provided the numbers make sense.

Yes to a scoping call on 2 May. For that call I’ll have: our infra lead (Samir), one engineer who owns the backfill pipeline (Priya), and product (Jordan).

Minor ask: can you include an estimated monthly run-rate post-pilot for two scale scenarios (steady-state + peak 3x spikes)? If you can attach that to the proposal, Margo will have an easier time with the numbers.

—Alex
Alex Moreno | Head of ML Ops | BrightGrid Systems
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightgrid.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:46:05 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid renewal & expansion play + action plan

Great — thanks Alex. I’ll update the proposal with the two scenario run-rates (steady-state and 3x peak) and add a short appendix on audit log retention and per-request tracing.

Proposed next steps / logistics: 
- 2 May 2027, 10:00–10:45 PT — Technical scoping (Samir, Priya, Jordan) — Dev/Monica to join and confirm runtime optimizations.
- By 10 May — Redwood to deliver final pilot SOW + DocuSign link.
- By 20 May — Target procurement approval window (Margo) / PO issuance.
- Pilot starts: earliest 1 June (subject to PO + signed SOW).

Quick notes on pilot configuration we plan to test: 
- Dedicated pool: 2x A100 nodes, optimized kernel selection for causal transformer models.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching turned on for RAG paths; TTLs set to maximize reuse of repeated prompts.
- Batching policy: continuous batching with lower latency floor for short-gen requests.

I’ve attached: redwood-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf and a success criteria checklist. Dev / Monica — please prepare a short runbook we can reference during the scoping call (networking ports, expected traffic patterns, and internal contact for infra).

If this looks right I’ll send the DocuSign link for the pilot SOW and lock the May 2 scoping slot.

Thanks —
Stephanie

Attachment stubs:
- redwood-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf
- pilot-success-criteria-checklist.xlsx
From: Margo Lee <margo.lee@brightgrid.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightgrid.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:08:12 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid renewal & expansion play + action plan

All —

I’ll start the PO workflow once we have the final pilot SOW and a ballpark estimate for post-pilot run-rate (steady / peak). Please include Redwood’s invoice remit address and tax ID on the SOW so procurement can process faster.

Also: can you confirm whether the pilot price you listed is refundable/creditable against a committed annual contract? That will be a key ask from procurement.

Thanks —
Margo Lee
Director of Procurement | BrightGrid Systems
